[[File:Exar_Kun_brazier.jpg|thumb|150px|A Sith brazier.]]
A '''brazier''' was a container used for holding fire, usually in the form of a shallow basin or bowl. Braziers were on either side of the base of the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]], and multiple braziers surrounded the sacrificial altar of [[Darth Drear]]'s [[Odacer-Faustin]] [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]].
